tool_args.rationale: The pilots show positive short-window gain but do not establish whether delayed adaptation suppresses or reverses the response at H = 20. The targeted long-horizon probe tests that distinction before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have H ≤ 0.48. If adaptation is slow, its amplitude and time constant enter the short-window response mainly through their ratio, leaving the H = 20 forecast poorly constrained.
It captures delayed adaptation but omits the observed sink-gradient signature.
The slightly cheaper probe adds resolution but does not directly test the long-horizon response.
